buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract

quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS 1. Experience and Past Performance: The bidder should have at least three years of experience in providing/deploying manpower under similar service cont racts. Further, the bidder should have successfully executed at least three man power supply contracts, each having a value of not less than ₹50 lakh, with diff erent Government Departments, Central/State Government Organisations, Publi c Sector Undertakings (PSUs) or Autonomous Bodies during the last three financ ial years. The bidder shall submit copies of the relevant Work Orders/Agreement s along with satisfactory Work Completion or Performance Certificates as docum entary proof of the above experience. 2. Statutory Registrations and Tax Documents: The bidder must possess a valid PAN and GST Registration, as applicable under the prevailing GST laws. Self-attested copies of PAN, GST Registration Certificate and Income Tax Return s, along with acknowledgements for the last three financial years, shall be uploa ded with the bid. 3. Financial Documents: The bidder shall submit copies of audited Balance S heets and Profit & Loss Accounts for the last three financial years, duly certified by a Chartered Accountant (CA), as evidence of its financial standing. In case a ny financial year is not covered by audited statements due to the bidder's eligib ility or applicable statutory provisions, the relevant CA-certified financial docum ents shall be submitted. 4. Existing Office in Dehradun: The bidder should have an established and o perational office within Dehradun District for at least three months prior to the date of publication of the bid, to ensure effective local coordination and smooth execution of the contract. Documentary proof of the office address, such as own ership documents or a valid rent/lease agreement, along with recent electricity bill or other utility bill, shall be submitted with the bid. A mere undertaking to es tablish an office after award of the contract shall not be accepted. 5. EPF and ESI Registration: The bidder shall possess valid registration with t he Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) and Employees' State Insura nce Corporation (ESIC), wherever applicable under the prevailing statutory prov isions. Copies of the relevant registration certificates/allotment letters shall be s ubmitted with the bid. 6. Proof of Statutory Compliance with Monthly Bills: Along with each mon thly bill, the service provider shall submit documentary proof of payment of wag es to the deployed personnel, EPF and ESI contributions, wherever applicable, in cluding relevant ECRs/challans and other documents required to establish statutory compliance. The service provider shall also submit a valid GST invoice and other applicable tax-related documents. The monthly bill shall be processe

d subject to submission and verification of the requisite supporting documents a nd compliance with the applicable contractual and statutory requirements. 7. Annual Turnover: The bidder should have an annual turnover of not less th an ₹1 crore during the immediately preceding financial year. A certificate issue d by a Chartered Accountant, along with the relevant audited financial stateme nts, shall be submitted as documentary proof. 8. Minimum Wages, VDA and Statutory Contributions: The rates quoted b y the bidder towards wages, including Basic Wages and Variable Dearness Allow ance (VDA), shall not be less than the minimum rates of wages notified by the C entral Government for the applicable category of workers and area of employm ent, under the Code on Wages, 2019 and the rules made thereunder. The bidde r shall strictly comply with the applicable Minimum Wages/VDA Orders, includin g all revisions issued by the competent authority from time to time, with effect f rom their respective effective dates. The bidder shall also ensure timely payme nt and deposit of EPF, ESI and all other applicable statutory contributions and b enefits in accordance with the Code on Social Security, 2020 and other applicab le statutory provisions, as amended from time to time. 9. Police Verification: The service provider shall ensure that police verificatio n of each deployed personnel is completed and a copy of the relevant verificatio n document is submitted to the Department within 15 days from the date of de ployment of that personnel. The service provider shall be responsible for ensuri ng that only personnel with satisfactory antecedents are deployed. 10. Compliance with Applicable Laws: The service provider shall comply wit h all applicable laws, rules, regulations and statutory requirements relating to it s business and the deployment of manpower, including labour laws, minimum w ages, EPF, ESI, GST, income tax and other applicable statutory obligations, as a mended from time to time. 11. Deployment of Manpower: The service provider shall arrange and deploy the requisite number of personnel within three days from the date of ex ecution of the agreement/issuance of the work order, as applicable, or within su ch other period as may be specified by the Department. The service provider sh all ensure that the deployed personnel meet the requirements and instructions communicated by the Department. 12. Engagement of Additional Workers: In case additional workers are requ ired to be engaged during the contract period, the wages payable to such work ers shall be as per the applicable rates of minimum wages, including VDA, notifi ed by the competent authority and prevailing at the time of their engagement, along with applicable statutory contributions and benefits. 13. Medical Fitness: The service provider shall ensure that each deployed per sonnel is medically fit to perform the assigned duties. A medical fitness certifica te issued by a Government Hospital or a registered medical practitioner shall be submitted to the Department within 15 days from the date of deployment of the concerned personnel. 14. Deployment and Coordination: The deployment of personnel shall be m ade in consultation with and subject to the approval of the Department. The De partment shall communicate its requirements regarding the number and place

ment of personnel, and the service provider shall make necessary arrangement s accordingly. 15 Applicability of Other Terms and Conditions: All other terms and condit ions stipulated in the Bid Document and the GeM Service Level Agreement (SLA ) applicable to Manpower Outsourcing Services – Minimum Wage Based shall re main applicable and shall be binding upon the successful bidder. Note: The bidder shall upload only those documents specifically required under the bid. Submission of irrelevant or unnecessary documents shall not substitute for the documents specifically prescribed under the bid and may be dealt with i n accordance with the applicable bid conditions. . 3. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.
